extract:
Podcast A is "{anchor}". Below are episodes from podcast A's own feed whose titles suggest promotion.
For each episode, decide whether the episode mainly promotes, previews, feed-drops, trailer-swaps, or crosses over with a DIFFERENT podcast (not podcast A itself, not a new season of A). If yes, give that other podcast's title exactly as written in the episode text. If not, or if no other podcast title is stated, give "".
Episodes:
{eps}
Return JSON only: {"episodes": [{"n": <episode number>, "other_podcast": "<title or empty>"}]} with one entry per episode.
